description.value: Sun Star Restaurant has been a community fixture in Coquitlam since 1996, serving a blend of Chinese and Canadian cuisine from its location inside the Ramada Inn on Lougheed Highway. The family-run establishment is known for its signature breakfast combos and spicy wontons, which have become a crowd favourite at the annual local Dumpling Festival. It also offers a private bar and lounge that can accommodate parties of up to 25, as well as online ordering for pickup and delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, family-run Chinese-Canadian restaurant at 631 Lougheed Hwy, Coquitlam (attached to the Ramada Inn), with explicit pickup/delivery ordering and dine-in service. No cyclist-specific amenities—bike parking, racks, water refill, washrooms—are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving all required criteria as null. Two discrepancies exist: OSM lists the community as 'North Vancouver' while the website clearly places the business in Coquitlam, and the OSM name appends 'Chinese' while the business's own branding is consistently 'Sun Star Restaurant'.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the website and postal address confirm the business is in Coquitlam, BC.
OSM name 'Sun Star Chinese Restaurant' does not match the business's own branding 'Sun Star Restaurant' used consistently throughout the website.
Restaurant is located inside/attached to the Ramada Inn — not a standalone street-front premises; cyclists should be aware of the hotel-lobby access context.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active restaurant useful for a meal stop, but all three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed; on-site verification or a staff call would be needed before including in the WWC directory.
